texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: Do you have any advice for how to “manage up”?
texts.text: Q: Do you have any advice for how to “manage up”?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Managing up, a.k.a managing your manager, is an essential skill at every level (even CEO). It enables you do your best work, while getting the recognition you deserve. A few behaviors and tactics that have helped me over the years:
texts.text: Managing up, a.k.a managing your manager, is an essential skill at every level (even CEO). It enables you do your best work, while getting the recognition you deserve. A few behaviors and tactics that have helped me over the years:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Over-communicate
texts.text: Over-communicate

texts.label: text
texts.orig: : Consistently share what you plan to do, what you’re doing, and what you did. It’s nearly impossible to over-communicate. I started sending a weekly “State of Me” email to my boss, with (1) things they can help me with, (2) my current priorities, and (3) things on my mind. It worked wonders.
texts.text: : Consistently share what you plan to do, what you’re doing, and what you did. It’s nearly impossible to over-communicate. I started sending a weekly “State of Me” email to my boss, with (1) things they can help me with, (2) my current priorities, and (3) things on my mind. It worked wonders.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Set expectations
texts.text: Set expectations

texts.label: text
texts.orig: : When taking on work, set realistic expectations around time, resources needed, and quality. Your performance will be judged based on how it compared to your manager’s expectations. Be ambitious, but also be realistic.
texts.text: : When taking on work, set realistic expectations around time, resources needed, and quality. Your performance will be judged based on how it compared to your manager’s expectations. Be ambitious, but also be realistic.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Share the trade-offs
texts.text: Share the trade-offs

texts.label: text
texts.orig: : When asked to make changes to a plan, be transparent about the trade-offs. Don’t assume they know what you know. What will suffer? What will benefit? What do you recommend? Partner with your manager to make the best decision.
texts.text: : When asked to make changes to a plan, be transparent about the trade-offs. Don’t assume they know what you know. What will suffer? What will benefit? What do you recommend? Partner with your manager to make the best decision.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Prioritize and communicate
texts.text: Prioritize and communicate

texts.label: text
texts.orig: : When asked to take on additional work, particularly last minutes, prioritize it amongst your existing priorities and share your updated priorities with your manager. Ask them if they disagree — adjust if so.
texts.text: : When asked to take on additional work, particularly last minutes, prioritize it amongst your existing priorities and share your updated priorities with your manager. Ask them if they disagree — adjust if so.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Do great work
texts.text: Do great work

texts.label: text
texts.orig: : The better you do -> the more your manager will trust you -> the more freedom and influence you will have. If you feel micro-managed, and others around you don’t, it’s likely because you aren’t performing well. Do great work and life will get better.
texts.text: : The better you do -> the more your manager will trust you -> the more freedom and influence you will have. If you feel micro-managed, and others around you don’t, it’s likely because you aren’t performing well. Do great work and life will get better.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: As a PM, when the team is humming along, what should I do when I have extra time?
texts.text: Q: As a PM, when the team is humming along, what should I do when I have extra time?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Work your way up this stack, finding ways to refine and optimize each step:
texts.text: Work your way up this stack, finding ways to refine and optimize each step:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Execution —> Strategy —> Vision
texts.text: Execution —> Strategy —> Vision

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Execution:
texts.text: Execution:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Does everyone know what they’ll be doing next?
texts.text: Does everyone know what they’ll be doing next?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Are there any blockers slowing down the team, now or approaching?
texts.text: Are there any blockers slowing down the team, now or approaching?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Are there any processes that could be improved?
texts.text: Are there any processes that could be improved?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Are you on track to hit your goals? What are 3 things you could do to increase those odds?
texts.text: Are you on track to hit your goals? What are 3 things you could do to increase those odds?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Strategy:
texts.text: Strategy:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Do you have a clear plan for how your team will achieve its mission?
texts.text: Do you have a clear plan for how your team will achieve its mission?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Is the strategy easy to understand and find? If you ask anyone on your team what your strategy is, would they be able to explain it?
texts.text: Is the strategy easy to understand and find? If you ask anyone on your team what your strategy is, would they be able to explain it?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: If you had to be more bold, what would you change?
texts.text: If you had to be more bold, what would you change?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Vision
texts.text: Vision

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Is it clear to you what long-term success for your team and product concretely looks like? Is there a North Star for your team?
texts.text: Is it clear to you what long-term success for your team and product concretely looks like? Is there a North Star for your team?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Is this also clear to your team?
texts.text: Is this also clear to your team?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Does achieving your vision matter? Remind people why.
texts.text: Does achieving your vision matter? Remind people why.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: And last, a few things you can always do more of:
texts.text: And last, a few things you can always do more of:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Communicate: Is there any additional communication you can do, within your team and to key stakeholders?
texts.text: Communicate: Is there any additional communication you can do, within your team and to key stakeholders?

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: Listen: What challenges is your team having that you haven’t yet recognized?
texts.text: Listen: What challenges is your team having that you haven’t yet recognized?

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: How can I differentiate my product/business from potential competitors, in the eyes of our customers?
texts.text: Q: How can I differentiate my product/business from potential competitors, in the eyes of our customers?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: With so much noise and competition it’s crucial that your offering stands out. Customers need a reason to choose you over the nearly identical competition. What makes you different and better? This is where differentiation comes in. Here’s twenty ways you can differentiate your product or business:
